Once per Doom Quarter, re-roll a Skill Check and add 1 extra Skill Die to the Dice Pool for the re-roll.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.72
system.summary: Once per Doom Quarter, re-roll a Skill Check and add 1 extra Skill Die to the Dice Pool for the re-roll.

when.label: Deus Ex Machina re-roll (+1 Skill Die)

automation.note: After one of your Skill Checks, Use this to spend the Doom Quarter's use, then roll the same check again with the Deus Ex Machina box ticked (+1 Skill Die). The re-roll's result replaces the first.
